assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only konosuba:mammon@original-light-novel#scoped-cohort-monograph, the active_provisional KONOSUBA_MAMMON_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of MAIN17 U01292-371 and U012468-469 present action, reached through Kazuma's narration while he impersonates Nos, together with YORI04 U014530-540 retrospective testimony by a professional adventurer that the monograph joins to Mammon as a high-confidence cross-source inference with a tentative name. The KonoSuba CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md and the cohort 49 evidence index rows (including join C49-M01) were read for method, authority order and scope only. The cohort 49 audits, provenance and gate records, the Nos monograph, ledgers and the Japanese source are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. No image, whole-edition, independent-reader or primary-source inspection is included.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The single MAIN17 U012 hall episode, from his recognition of Logia's corpse (U01292) to his fall from Kazuma's concealed attack (U012363-371), and his corpse at U012468-469 with the fatal transition unisolated. The YORI04 testimony describes an earlier mission and a reported promotion only as an opponent's hearsay; publication order does not make it a later state. No default state exists before or after the episode, and no in-world calendar time is fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph states that a face-sensitive supervisor hypothesis, a limited-cruelty hypothesis and ordinary tactical management predict overlapping behavior in this episode and that no discriminating case promotes one into a generative mechanism; it supplies no model or rule inventory. That supports bounded canon questions about one command episode.

Within one episode the monograph orders located shifts: wrong causal reconstruction of Logia's death (U01292-100), the hostage broadcast (U012165), interrogation and tea (U012175-237), relief, praise and a promised bonus (U012240-271), hesitation then the stop order (U012306/321-334), boasting (U012343-362) and his fall (U012363-371). His earlier career is only an opponent's hearsay (YORI04U014530-540). This is not a developmental trajectory.

Located printed functions: plain rough speech with 俺 and direct commands, the operational office announcement (U012165), the methodical question series (U012175), a brief supervisory apology (U012205), a hesitant objection (U012306), a definite stop command (U012334) and repeated self-naming and denial of fear (U012350). The monograph disclaims acoustic certification, a Japanese generation grammar and a stable private register, and keeps Kazuma's Nos impersonation out of his voice.

The monograph states that food preferences cannot be read from an ordered last tea, financial character from an unpaid promised bonus, and that family, leisure and private obligations are unknown. No ordinary-life repertoire is established, which is not evidence that he lacks one.

Differentiated conduct toward subordinates (restraint, rebuke, apology and a completed blow, U012181-217; praise and a promised bonus, U012240-271), the apparent Nos (coaching history and a detected but misclassified mismatch, U012119-127), the Axis prisoner Aqua (coercion, interrogation and tea), Mitsurugi (challenge and response, U012321-334) and the hidden intruder (dismissal, U012343-362). Each rests on one scene.

There is no focalization through Mammon; his hesitation and denial of fear are spoken acts graded elsewhere, and the recollecting adventurer's wish for his death belongs to the adventurer. No interior model is established.

The hostage demand under threat of killing (U012165), the issued but uncompleted kill order (U012240-271), the self-assigned fight and boast (U012334-362), and a fall from concealed attack whose disabling cause the narration leaves between a skill and poison (U012363-371). The opponent's testimony of past fighting power (YORI04U014535-539) is reputation, not witnessed combat; his fall is not a test of fair combat.

The one located limit: he stops further humiliation of prisoners while keeping them hostage (U012306/321-334). The monograph keeps its cause contested among prior hesitation, Mitsurugi's rebuke, recovery of knightly bearing and his own tactical-sufficiency explanation, and sets it beside the unjust blow to a server (U012217). This is ordinary unresolved ambiguity, not contradiction, and supports no rule of honor.
The comedy of the reputation-versus-infiltration juxtaposition and of the disguise belongs to the work and to Kazuma's performance; no play of Mammon's own is located.

One MAIN17 U012 episode range plus the YORI04 U014530-540 retrospective hearsay joined by inference, reached through Kazuma's narration; the curated item is a bounded cohort monograph, not new whole-book primary reading.

Affirmative located countercases: a wrong causal account of Logia's death from incomplete information (U01292-100/175) against omniscience; a detected but misclassified speech mismatch (U012119-127); an apology beside an unjust blow (U012205/217); stopping humiliation while keeping hostages (U012334); and boasting after expressed concern about the intruder (U012233 against U012350). They are one project's adjudication of one episode.

Claims are bound to unit and paragraph locators; the YORI04 history is kept apart from present action and is not read as a post-death return, one completed blow (U012217) is separated from an interrupted attempt (U012240), and an issued kill order from a completed one. There is no default state or knowledge cutoff beyond the episode.

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph supports phrasing- and pragmatics-sensitive description of one command role and warns against both an unthinking roar and a uniformly courteous knight, but establishes no stable register for new lines. Located forms can check a proposed line for contradiction.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The MAIN17 U012 hall episode, U01292 to U012371, with the stop order and boast the last attested states before his fall.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: His subordinates and server; the apparent Nos (Kazuma in disguise); the Axis prisoner Aqua; Mitsurugi and the other captives; the hidden intruder as an absent feared enemy.
setting_constraints: The hall before the Demon King's room during the MAIN17 infiltration, with hostages held
No earlier mission beyond the YORI04 hearsay, no private or domestic setting and no uncurated evidence
Printed Japanese only, no performed voice

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph states the restraint is not proof he would choose the same in private, without witnesses, under greater danger or toward a different prisoner, and that no discriminating cases support a generative mechanism. A novel situation inside the scope can be checked against located conduct, not predicted.
No ordinary social scene is narrated; the ordered tea is a coercive hospitality act within the interrogation. Nothing is established either way.
His single located limit has an unseparated cause and a precise ceiling, and the monograph declines a universally calibrated rule of honor; no procedure for a new ethical choice follows.
Nothing romantic is established, which neither supports nor denies readiness.

Command conduct is the material's centre (interrogation, supervision, discipline, reward, hostage policy, self-assigned combat), but it is one episode with overlapping explanations, and the monograph withholds a model; no procedure for his command in another situation follows.

known_limits.statement: The YORI04 professional adventurer's goat-headed knight, tentatively named Mammon, with one two-handed axe and a reported promotion to the Demon King's guard (YORI04U014530-540), is a high-confidence cross-source inference with tentativeness and hearsay preserved, not an explicit identity equation, a first-person confession or a witnessed battle; the adventurer's wish for his death is the adventurer's.

He stops further humiliation of prisoners but keeps hostage taking and armed coercion (U012306/321-334); the cause is not separated among prior hesitation, Mitsurugi's rebuke, face, tactical sufficiency and limited aversion to cruelty, so neither moral clearance nor limitlessness may be inferred.

Kazuma's Nos impersonation, hostage proposals and self-praise are Kazuma's performances (U012119-127/279); Mammon's errors arise from an incomplete security picture and he cannot be credited with the narrator's knowledge.
One completed blow (U012217) and one interrupted attempt (U012240) are located; Aqua's purification of the tea is not the server's sabotage, so the punishment cannot be justified as a response to it.
The disabling cause of his fall is left between a skill and poison (U012363-371), and the corpse report (U012468-469) identifies no fatal stroke, time or exclusive killer.
Food preferences, finances, family, leisure, private obligations and enduring relationships are unknown; missing support is not evidence that any trait or capacity is absent.
The cohort 49 audits, provenance and gate records, the Nos monograph, ledgers and the Japanese source are not curated on this subject and were not assessed.
